title: Public sign, timing and unit conventions fixed by tiny computations

fixture.dft: 400 samples at dt = 1e-16 s, ten whole cycles (f0 = 2.5e14 Hz); complex exponentials and sin traces through direct_transform, point_spectrum (custom and fft) and DifferentiableResult.spectrum
fixture.planes: tests/test_plan.py::scene field-monitor variant in float64 without structures, 11 steps, one custom frequency 2e14 Hz; native Simulation and DifferentiablePlaneSimulation against a full-state _System reference applying the documented sample times
fixture.bloch: the same scene with Bloch y faces, phase 0.7, an Ez sheet; BoundaryDescription wrap, source_profile, interpolation_map at both seams, YeeGrid.curl forward and backward on exp(i k y) with k = (0.7 + 2 pi)/L
fixture.half_step: the scene with 40 steps, an Ez and an Hy continuous point source, Ez and Hy point monitors
fixture.flux: synthetic plane_result with E_y = 1, H_z = +/-1 on one 2e-12 m^2 point; a 2D y-periodic sheet run (3 x 0.6 um, 0.05 um, 800 steps, 8 PML cells, float64) with an Ez sheet at x = -1 um and x-normal monitors of width 0.3 and 0.6 um at x = 0.5 um windowed by a full Gaussian apodization (center 60 fs, width 20 fs), then the sheet at x = +1 um
fixture.units: dt of the 2D scene; a 3D 1.6 um cube with a 1 x 0.8 um x-normal plane; Drude (wp 1.3e16, gamma 1e14, eps_inf 1.5) permittivity at 2e14 Hz; Lorentz ADE coefficient at the plan dt
fixture.exterior: tests/test_radiation.py::dipole_faces with n = 1.3 + 0.05i, far field at 50 and 60 um

reference_method: closed-form identities: geometric sums over whole cycles, the documented DFT and sample-time formulas evaluated by explicit stepping, Bloch difference formulas, the Poynting density formula, linear scaling of a y-uniform wave, eta_0 = 1 plane-wave impedance, the SI CFL formula, the Drude formula, the far-field (r1/r2) exp(-Im k (r2 - r1)) decay

observables.name: dft_sign_and_scale
observables.definition: value at +f0 for exp(-2 pi i f0 t) and the phase of sin under the native, legacy FFT and differentiable transforms

observables.name: plane_dft_agreement
observables.definition: native and differentiable plane fields versus the explicit-formula reference

observables.name: bloch_phase
observables.definition: wrap factor, sheet profile, seam interpolation weights and seam curl values

observables.name: sample_times
observables.definition: Result.times, H spectra time shift, source sample times

observables.name: flux_sign_and_scaling
observables.unit: reduced E*H * s^2 * m per invariant length
observables.definition: flux of the 0.3 and 0.6 um monitors, |Hy|/|Ez|, flux versus 0.5 sum |Ez|^2 width, flux of the reversed wave

observables.name: units
observables.definition: dt formula, 3D weights in m^2, permittivity, ADE coefficient, unit strings

acceptance.exact_identities: 1e-9 relative on whole-cycle DFT values and phases; 1e-12 relative on Bloch and permittivity formulas; exact equality on sample times and unit strings
acceptance.source_of_limits: identities tighter than completion_gates.json discrete_dimensionless_fp64 (rtol 1e-7, atol 1e-9) where a formula is exact; the 2 % impedance and sheet-power budgets are fixture-specific Yee dispersion and windowing allowances declared before the run

not_yet_covered: oblique-incidence flux sign on y-normal and z-normal monitors in 3D
the tiled and stitched plane conventions

notes: docs/CONVENTIONS.md lists every statement with the test that fixes it; the closed-box outward-normal statement is fixed by the existing tests/test_radiation.py dipole convergence test.
